healthRisks.headline: High Blood Sugar Today Can Affect Your Health Tomorrow
healthRisks.description: Diabetes is not just about blood sugar readings. When blood sugar remains elevated over time, it can contribute to complications affecting different parts of the body.
healthRisks.calloutBox: Understanding your health risks is an important step towards making informed decisions about your care.

impacts.title: Heart Health
impacts.desc: Uncontrolled diabetes can increase the risk of cardiovascular disease and stroke.

impacts.title: Kidney Health
impacts.desc: Persistently high blood sugar can damage the kidneys over time.

impacts.title: Vision Health
impacts.desc: Diabetes can damage the blood vessels in the eyes and affect vision.

impacts.title: Nerve Health
impacts.desc: Diabetes-related nerve damage may cause tingling, numbness, or pain, particularly in the feet.

impacts.title: Wound Healing
impacts.desc: Diabetes can affect healing and increase the risk of certain infections.

about.headline: Meet Dt. Bhavna Bhanushali
paragraphs: Bhavna Bhanushali is a Certified Diabetes Educator and Health Coach with 10+ years of experience, dedicated to helping people improve their overall health and achieve better blood sugar management through practical nutrition and sustainable lifestyle changes.
Her approach focuses on supporting blood sugar management, weight management, and healthier everyday habits without extreme dieting or starvation.
Through the Reset Blueprint, she guides individuals towards a more balanced lifestyle with a focus on real food, personalised nutrition, and long-term well-being.

items.question: Can diabetes be managed naturally through nutrition and lifestyle changes?
items.answer: Nutrition and lifestyle changes can support blood sugar management and overall health. The right approach depends on your individual health needs and should complement medical care.

items.question: Do I need to follow a strict diet or starve myself?
items.answer: No. The focus is on practical, balanced eating habits and sustainable lifestyle changes rather than extreme dieting or starvation.

items.question: Can I reduce belly fat while working on my blood sugar levels?
items.answer: Healthy eating, regular physical activity, and consistent lifestyle habits can support weight management and better blood sugar control. Results vary from person to person.

items.question: Will I receive a personalised nutrition plan?
items.answer: The guidance focuses on your individual needs, food preferences, daily routine, and health goals to help you build practical and sustainable habits. Explain the exact deliverables during the consultation.

items.question: How can I get started with the Reset Blueprint?
items.answer: You can book a consultation to discuss your health goals, current lifestyle, and nutritional needs and understand how personalised guidance may help you.
